title: Cited Trends quality: surprise-ranked signals, notable makers, records out of the topic model
description: Shipped has real volume (1,338 entities, ~2,600 Hub monitor records on 2026-10-26) and the trend signals are dominated by generic entities. Rank entity signals by Poisson surprise over the entity's own prior four weeks and the corpus growth, demote licence/task/platform (context only, never anchors), require makers to be notable (watchlist, own item, or >=2 models with likes/downloads above a threshold), apply the same score to the snapshot's trending list, and keep monitor records out of topic-model clusters (they split 5,000 Hub lines into 27 maker clusters). topicCount counts beats, not clusters. Follow-up to PPY-fb4dfa.
